name: Rafiq
description: A Bant knight-general to whom Estel is told to bring the box.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret sends Estel with the box and an enchanted knife to Bant, telling him to say an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent him.
timeline.quote: When you see Rafiq, tell him that an ally of Elspeth Tirel sent you.
